title: No response from developer
body:
The app is exceptionally good but I noticed some bugs. Had some feature suggestions also. Tried to reach  out the developer many times but he is not responsive at all.

Edit : After reading developer’s response I am degrading rating to 1 star from  2. Have some general decency. You need to learn something from your own app. It’s not blackmailing but a generous kind request put forward in polite way. Apart from that I mailed you regarding apple watch app bug also. You never cared to reply. Tells much about you. 

Instead of showing arrogance to users a simple no would be better and I agree with you, pricing should be fair for all. Same line could have been written in mail respond but nevermind luckily I took the right decision to cancel my annual subscription on last day of free 7 day trial.

As I said in the start, it’s an exceptional app. I respect the hardwork you have put. 5/5 rating for app but 0/5 for your behaviour. Best wishes for future of your app.
